target_text: // NaN poison: a dead-token value reaching a live score fails the envelope.
body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

'Only live tokens are stored' restates the if on line 266, and 'NaN poison' restates the argument NAN_POISON_0X7FC1 whose comment on line 230 already says it is the dead tokens' storage. A call-site comment states the placement reason: poison before the stores so that a read of a dead token is observable.

Proposed:
```cpp
    // NaN poison: a dead-token value reaching a live score fails the envelope.
```
